Class RouteAssembly

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.web.router.RouteAssembly
@Internal public final class RouteAssembly extends Object
Assembles the routes of a route builder into route infos: the machinery shared by the route builders. The legacy DefaultRouteBuilder and the routes to handler functions of HttpRouteBuilder both add their routes here, and the router reads them from here.
Since:
5.3.0
Author:
Denis Stepanov

    • addImplicitHeadRoutes

      public void addImplicitHeadRoutes()
      Add an implicit HEAD route for every GET route that has no HEAD route for the same URI, like AnnotatedMethodRouteBuilder does for @Get methods. Each HEAD route is a copy of the finished GET route.
